ritual.linePrev: Oh, good God, let me give you my life
ritual.line: No masters or kings when the ritual begins
ritual.lineNext: There is no sweeter innocence than our gentle sin
stanza: No masters or kings when the ritual begins
There is no sweeter innocence than our gentle sin
In the madness and soil of that sad earthly scene
Only then, I am human, only then, I am clean
